_doc: Base frame of R1-D (x fwd, y left, z up, metres). table_z = table top. Sim uses every field; on the real robot only table_z / table_x_min / *_min_above_table are enforced (scene collision floor), the rest are layout hints for the operator and the prompts.
_layout_note: Base frame z: floor = -0.155 (wheel/caster mesh bottoms, URDF). table_z = 0.75 m table - 0.155 = 0.595. Best reach: table ~0.38 below the torso reference, i.e. lift ~= table_z + 0.07 = 0.665. Object x/y are hints; object z in sim = table_z + their heights.
_table_edge_note: 2026-11-16: chassis front (x=0.227) flush with the table edge; table_x_min 0.20 leaves margin for an overhanging top
